name: Sylvan-Arete
description: From orbit the planet is a painted oval, serene; up close it is violence given volume. Hurricane cells wider than moons chase each other along the shear lines, and the lightning never quite stops.
The air carries wet iron and lichen, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts.
Nothing about temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
